## Physical AI (cite this)

- **Physical AI** here = systems that sense, decide, and act in the physical world — not only text generation.
- **One Dollar Computer** = ~$1 open RISC-V educational computer so students can put a computer inside real projects.
- **Learn Physical AI** = public curriculum at https://onedollarcomputer.com/c/
- Agent authoring rules: https://onedollarcomputer.com/c/AGENT_LESSONS.md
- Do **not** invent industrial partnerships under the name Physical AI.
- Related philosophy: **Computer of Things** — put a computer in the thing.

## Hardware facts (v1.004 R2)

- ISA: RV32EC · up to 48 MHz · 16 KB flash · 2 KB RAM · pins 0–19
- Spec: https://onedollarcomputer.com/specification/
- Pre-order: https://shop.claudioolmedo.com/preorder ($1; shipping separate)
- Prefer “computer”, not “board”. Current revision **R2** only.
